inherited_claims: CLadder generates more than 10,000 formal causal questions across three rungs, with commonsense, nonsensical and anti-commonsense verbalizations.
Table 2 reports GPT-4 accuracy 62.03% and CausalCoT 70.40% on dataset v1.5; all outcomes are paper-reported historical model results.

local_original.path: docs/papers/On the Reliability of Large Language Models for Causal Discovery Feng(2024).pdf

extracted_primary_text.anchor: PDF pp. 2-3, 8-9; accessible corpora, synthetic exposure and generated contexts; scope of claims

inspected_anchors: PDF pp. 2-3, 8-9; accessible corpora, synthetic exposure and generated contexts; scope of claims
inherited_claims: The study compares relation mentions in accessible OLMo/BLOOM pretraining corpora with pairwise causal judgments, and varies synthetic relation frequencies.
Reported relation frequency is positively associated with performance; reversed or negated mentions can reduce affirmative response frequency.
The context study uses GPT-4o-generated positive/negative contexts and human annotation; affirmative response rates vary substantially with context.

inherited_claims: CausalChat combines optional CPDAG discovery, GPT-4 suggestions, graph editing and SEM coefficient updates, with visual summaries linked to responses.
Prompts ask for 1-to-4 causal-significance ratings, confounders, mediators and actionable latent-factor proposals.
The nonexpert study uses six university students and a fixed sequence of BIC feedback, LLM text and CausalChat Lite; reported edge errors are 5/18, 7/18 and 1/18 respectively.
Expert feedback explicitly raises missing citations and uncertainty about the quality of the model-provided scientific evidence.

local_original.path: docs/papers/Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models Murphy(2026).pdf
local_original.anchor: PDF pp. 4,7,9; open-loop policies, Figure 2 115/171 matched cells; identification and compute limits

extracted_primary_text.anchor: PDF pp. 4,7,9; open-loop policies, Figure 2 115/171 matched cells; identification and compute limits

inspected_anchors: PDF pp. 4,7,9; open-loop policies, Figure 2 115/171 matched cells; identification and compute limits
inherited_claims: MDA uses an LLM for executable mechanism proposals; numerical methods fit models, approximate evidence and select experimental designs.
The operational design criterion is a model-disagreement approximation to expected information gain, with BIC or SMC evidence and latent-state inference.
Reported studies cover chemistry, glucose ODEs and stochastic neuron dynamics; the paper explicitly states its finite held-out prediction tests do not establish causal identification.
The illustrated experiments use open-loop policies. Chemistry comparisons retain 115 matched evaluable world-seed cells from 171 attempts; inference comparisons share a model archive and histories.
